description: This file defines the AttendanceRecordDecorator class, which provides methods to format and retrieve attendance record data, including punch-in and punch-out times, timezones, and related information, for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AttendanceRecordDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for AttendanceRecord providing formatted access to punch times, timezones, and related data.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee for the attendance record based on employee number.

methods.name: getAttendanceState
methods.description: Returns the attendance state in a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCtime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDate
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user date as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user time as a formatted string.

methods.name: getPunchInUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in user DateTime object, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchInUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-in UTC DateTime object, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchOutUserDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out user DateTime object, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchOutUTCDateTime
methods.description: Returns the punch-out UTC DateTime object, constructing it if necessary.

methods.name: getPunchInTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-in time.

methods.name: getPunchOutTimezoneLabel
methods.description: Returns the timezone label for punch-out time.
